name: charter-ts-workspace
description: charter's TypeScript side, as npm workspaces: the package charter-ts (packages/charter-ts: the charter-ts command and the library) and the projects made with it (examples/: start, one route; notes, the notes API with auth, streams and rate limits; showcase, every Fern feature with the SDK tested inside a Worker). npm ci installs them all and builds charter-ts; npm run check is every local check (Docker, no Cloudflare account); npm run release -- X.Y.Z cuts a release of charter-ts onto GitHub.

scripts.check: tsc && npm run check -w charter-ts && npm run build -w charter-ts && npm run check -w examples/start && npm run check -w examples/notes && npm run check -w examples/showcase
